# DSH Remote

> Pair an Android phone to a DeepSeek Harness Host on the same LAN.

DSH Remote is two downloads, not a fork of DeepSeek Harness, and not an official DeepSeek product.

1. Host plugin: https://github.com/w2112515/dsh-remote-host
   npm: @w2112515/dsh-remote-host
   Install: `dsh plugin --profile web add @w2112515/dsh-remote-host`
   Then restart `dsh web` and open Settings → Mobile access (not Settings → Plugins).
2. Android APK: https://github.com/w2112515/dsh-remote-android/releases
   Debug package id: `dev.dshremote.gate0c`
   The APK is a separate download, not a DSH plugin.

Facts:

- Pairing: Noise XXpsk3 / IK, Host QR, eight-digit compare code on the PC.
- LAN discovery is off until Mobile access enables it.
- Phone talks to the Host Remote port on the same `dsh web` process, not the Web UI port.
- Workspace paths never leave the Host. The phone sees labels, ids, and folder names.
- Create session: bind an existing Host workspace, or let the Host mkdir a child under an allowed parent.
- Reviewed Host security platform: Windows x64. Linux/macOS keep the settings page and skip the carrier.
- Same Wi-Fi / LAN only. No public relay in this release.
- Community marketplace catalogs may not list this plugin yet. npm install works now.

DeepSeek Harness: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
LINUX DO: this project acknowledges https://linux.do
